cases.name: Fix a signup form
cases.prompt: Improve signup.html using this skill. Keep a single email signup form and submit action. Use plain HTML and inline CSS only. Work only in this task folder. Do not use the network or install packages.

checks.name: Native evidence shows the target skill loaded
Form, email label, submit button, focus and font size

args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; const s=readFileSync('signup.html','utf8'); assert.match(s,/<form[\s>]/i); assert.match(s,/<input[^>]*type=["']email["']/i); assert.match(s,/<label[\s>]/i); assert.match(s,/<button[^>]*type=["']submit["']/i); assert.match(s,/font-size\s*:\s*(16px|1rem)/i); assert.match(s,/:focus-visible/); const input=s.match(/<input[^>]*>/i)[0]; const id=input.match(/id=["']([^"']+)/)?.[1]; assert.ok((id && s.includes('for="'+id+'"')) || /<label[^>]*>[\s\S]*<input[^>]*>[\s\S]*<\/label>/i.test(s));

cases.name: Handle concurrent form submission
cases.prompt: Fix submit.mjs using this skill. Keep createSubmitHandler(save, setBusy) returning an async handler. Prevent concurrent saves; release the busy state after either success or failure and let errors reach the caller. Work only in this task folder. Do not use the network or install packages.

checks.name: Native evidence shows the target skill loaded
One pending save, failure recovery, and later retry

args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {createSubmitHandler} from './submit.mjs'; let calls=0, resolve; const states=[]; const handler=createSubmitHandler(()=>{calls++;return new Promise(r=>resolve=r)},v=>states.push(v)); let prevented=0; const event={preventDefault(){prevented++}}; const first=handler(event); await handler(event); assert.equal(calls,1); resolve(); await first; assert.equal(states.at(-1),false); const next=handler(event); assert.equal(calls,2); resolve(); await next; const error=new Error('save failed'); let failures=0; const fail=createSubmitHandler(async()=>{failures++;throw error},v=>states.push(v)); await assert.rejects(fail(event),e=>e===error); assert.equal(states.at(-1),false); await assert.rejects(fail(event),e=>e===error); assert.equal(failures,2); assert.ok(prevented>=3);
